description: Starts a sequence that emails eligible contacts already in the trigger group and people who join from now on. Read automation_get, show the person the steps and current group size, then wait for a clear yes. Pass that size as expected_group_count and confirm: true. If the count changed by more than 5%, show the new count and get approval again. Tell the person if sending is held for first campaign review or setup. Requires API key scope: send.

confirm.description: Use true only after the person explicitly approved the steps and group size.

expected_group_count.description: The trigger_group_count from automation_get that the person approved.

id.description: Automation id from automations_list or automation_draft.

name: automation_activate
title: Activate automation
